_about: Modstoke Loader text, English. This is the source language: every other file translates these keys. Text in {braces} is filled in by the Loader and must stay as written.

about.normal: The game as it was made to be played: survive, build and find out what happened on the island.
about.hardSurvival: Hard, with harsher survival: less food to find, slower recovery and colder nights.
about.peaceful: No enemies. Explore and build at your own pace.
about.creative: Build freely with every item to hand and no need to eat, drink or rest.
about.custom: Set each rule yourself on the next page.

games.chooseMode: Choose how you want to play.
games.startFailed: That could not be started. The Loader log says why.

options.title: Options
options.none: Nothing to change here on this PC.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.about: The size of the picture in pixels. Your monitor's own resolution gives the sharpest image.

windowMode.name: Window mode
windowMode.about: Whether the game fills the screen or runs in a window.

vsync.name: Vertical sync
vsync.about: Matches each frame to your monitor's refresh, which stops tearing. It can add a little delay to your input.

maxFps.name: Frame rate limit
maxFps.about: The most frames per second the game draws. A limit keeps your PC cooler and quieter; Max removes it.

graphicsApi.name: Graphics API
graphicsApi.about: The graphics interface the game draws with. DirectX 11 is how the game ships. DirectX 12 comes with its engine and can run better on newer graphics cards, but the game was not made for it, so switch back if anything looks or runs wrong. A change applies the next time the game starts.

gamma.name: Gamma
gamma.about: Brightens or darkens the middle tones of the picture.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.about: Raises or lowers the brightness of the whole picture.

dlss.name: NVIDIA DLSS
dlss.about: Draws the game at a lower resolution and rebuilds a sharp picture from it, for more frames per second. Needs an NVIDIA RTX graphics card.

fsr3.name: AMD FSR 3
fsr3.about: Upscaling that raises the frame rate by drawing fewer pixels. Works on most graphics cards.

dynamicResolution.name: Dynamic resolution
dynamicResolution.about: Lets the game lower its drawing resolution in busy moments to keep the frame rate steady.

resolutionTarget.name: Resolution target
resolutionTarget.about: The share of the screen's resolution the game aims to draw at when dynamic resolution or upscaling is on.

qualityPreset.name: Quality preset
qualityPreset.about: Sets every graphics option at once. Each one can still be changed afterwards.

drawDistance.name: Draw distance
drawDistance.about: How far away the world is drawn in full detail.

textures.name: Texture resolution
textures.about: The detail of surfaces. Lower it if your graphics card runs short of memory.

grass.name: Grass
grass.about: How much grass is drawn and how far it reaches.

billboards.name: Distant trees
billboards.about: The quality of the simplified trees drawn far away.

terrainDetail.name: Ground detail
terrainDetail.about: How finely the shape of the ground is drawn close to you.

terrainDepth.name: Ground depth
terrainDepth.about: How far out the ground keeps its sense of depth and texture.

terrainFiltering.name: Ground filtering
terrainFiltering.about: Keeps the ground sharp when you see it at a shallow angle.

filtering.name: Texture filtering
filtering.about: Keeps surfaces sharp when you see them at a shallow angle.

shadows.name: Shadows
shadows.about: How sharp shadows are and how far they reach. One of the most demanding options.

ambientOcclusion.name: Ambient occlusion
ambientOcclusion.about: Soft shade where surfaces meet, which gives the world depth.

contactShadows.name: Contact shadows
contactShadows.about: Small, sharp shadows where things touch the ground.

microShadows.name: Micro shadows
microShadows.about: Fine shadow in the small details of surfaces.

reflections.name: Screen-space reflections
reflections.about: Reflections of what is on screen in water and wet surfaces.

fog.name: Fog
fog.about: The quality of fog and of light passing through it.

clouds.name: Clouds
clouds.about: How the clouds in the sky are drawn.

water.name: Water quality
water.about: The quality of lakes, rivers and the sea.

waterWaves.name: Water movement
waterWaves.about: Lets the surface of the water rise and fall with waves.

antiAliasing.name: Anti-aliasing
antiAliasing.about: Smooths jagged edges. TAA gives the smoothest result; SMAA and FXAA cost less.

motionBlur.name: Motion blur
motionBlur.about: Blurs the picture during fast movement.

chromaticAberration.name: Chromatic aberration
chromaticAberration.about: Color fringes toward the edges of the picture, as a camera lens makes.

filmGrain.name: Film grain
filmGrain.about: A fine grain over the picture, like film.

colorGrade.name: Color style
colorGrade.about: The overall color style of the picture.

gameLanguage.name: Game language
gameLanguage.about: The language of the game's text. Modstoke's menus follow it unless a language is chosen on the Modstoke tab.

subtitles.name: Subtitles
subtitles.about: Shows what is said as text on screen.

fov.name: Field of view
fov.about: Widens or narrows how much of the world you see.

hud.name: On-screen display
hud.about: Shows or hides everything drawn over the game while you play.

hudScale.name: Display size
hudScale.about: The size of what is drawn over the game while you play.

vitals.name: Vitals
vitals.about: Shows your health, hunger, thirst and energy.

minimap.name: Mini map
minimap.about: Shows the small map in the corner of the screen.

interaction.name: Interaction prompts
interaction.about: Shows the prompts for what you can pick up and use.

building.name: Building guides
building.about: Shows the guides and prompts while you build.

tutorials.name: Tips
tutorials.about: Shows tips while you learn the game.

reticle.name: Aiming mark
reticle.about: Shows where a bow or gun is aimed.

nameTags.name: Player names
nameTags.about: Shows other players' names above them.

treeRegrowth.name: Tree regrowth
treeRegrowth.about: Lets cut trees grow back over time.

structureDamage.name: Structure damage
structureDamage.about: Lets what you build be damaged.

skipBuildAnimations.name: Skip building animations
skipBuildAnimations.about: Places building pieces without their animation: never, in creative mode only, or always.

bigHeads.name: Big heads
bigHeads.about: A joke setting that makes heads much bigger.

mouseX.name: Mouse speed, sideways
mouseX.about: How fast the view turns as you move the mouse left and right.

mouseY.name: Mouse speed, up and down
mouseY.about: How fast the view turns as you move the mouse up and down.

invertY.name: Invert looking up and down
invertY.about: Pushing the mouse or stick up looks down.

aimX.name: Aiming speed, sideways
aimX.about: How fast the view turns sideways while you aim a ranged weapon.

aimY.name: Aiming speed, up and down
aimY.about: How fast the view turns up and down while you aim a ranged weapon.

padX.name: Stick speed, sideways
padX.about: How fast the view turns left and right with the controller's stick.

padY.name: Stick speed, up and down
padY.about: How fast the view turns up and down with the controller's stick.

deadzone.name: Stick dead zone
deadzone.about: How far a stick must move before it counts. Raise it if the view drifts by itself.

crouchToggle.name: Crouch toggle
crouchToggle.about: One press crouches and the next stands, instead of holding the button.

sprintToggle.name: Sprint toggle
sprintToggle.about: One press starts sprinting, instead of holding the button.

inventorySpeed.name: Inventory cursor speed
inventorySpeed.about: How fast the cursor moves over your inventory with a controller.

bindings.name: Keys and buttons
bindings.about: Change which keys and buttons do what, for keyboard and mouse and for a controller.

modBindings.name: Mod keys and buttons
modBindings.about: Keys and controller buttons for Modstoke and its mods. Choose one, then press the key or button you want for it.

effects.name: Sound effects
effects.about: The volume of the world and everything in it.

voices.name: Voices
voices.about: The volume of spoken lines and voice chat.

dynamicRange.name: Dynamic range
dynamicRange.about: How far apart quiet and loud sounds are kept. A narrower range suits small speakers or playing at night.

voiceCount.name: Sound channels
voiceCount.about: How many sounds can play at once. Lower it if the sound stutters.

proximityChat.name: Voice chat
proximityChat.about: How your microphone works in multiplayer: push to talk, or always on.

menus.name: Menus
menus.about: Modstoke's menus, or the game's own as they were. To come back from the game's menus, open Mods > Runtime Preferences and turn Classic Menus off.

menuSize.name: Menu size
menuSize.about: The size of Modstoke's menus and their text.

loadingScreen.name: Loading screen
loadingScreen.about: Modstoke's loading screen with pictures of the island and your own photos, or the game's own.

loadingArt.name: Loading pictures
loadingArt.about: Your photos of the world being loaded, then Modstoke's pictures of the island. Or only Modstoke's, or your photos of any world first.

textLanguage.name: Modstoke language
textLanguage.about: The language of Modstoke's own text, such as these menus. Following the game uses the game's language.

classicMenus.title: Use the game's own menus?
classicMenus.body: The game's own title, options and pause menus replace Modstoke's. To come back, open Mods > Runtime Preferences and turn Classic Menus off.

graphicsApi.fellBack: DirectX 12 did not start last time, so the game's own choice is back.
graphicsApi.hung: The graphics card stopped responding on DirectX 12 last time, so DirectX 11 is back from the next start.
graphicsApi.launchOptions: Your Steam launch options choose the graphics API, so this setting has no effect.

bindings.title: Keys and buttons
bindings.unavailable: The game's key bindings can't be read right now.

about.move: How you get around on foot. Each direction has a key of its own; on a controller they start on the left stick.
about.act: What you do with what is in your hands, and with the world around you.
about.gear: Bringing out the things you carry.
about.rest: Held down to sleep, or to save where the game lets you.
about.general: Talking to other players, and skipping scenes.
about.hotkeys: Takes out the item you put on each number.
about.inventory: Handling items while your inventory is open.
about.book: Finding your way around the guide book.
about.blueprints: Placing structures chosen in the guide book.
about.freeform: Building piece by piece, and taking structures apart.
about.drive: Driving the vehicles on the island.

bindings.hold: This one works when held down, so a quick press of the same key or button can do something else.
bindings.notOnPad: The game reads this from the keyboard only, so it has no controller button.
bindings.notOnKeyboard: The game reads this from a controller only.

listen.aboutKey: Press the key or mouse button for {action}. Nothing changes if you cancel or wait.
listen.aboutButton: Press the button for {action}. Nothing changes if you cancel or wait.

conflict.title: {key} is already in use
conflict.fixedLine: Used by {actions}, which can't be changed here.
conflict.mixedLine: Used by {actions}, and by {fixed}, which can't be changed here.

reset.title: Reset
reset.body: The bindings you changed go back to the game's defaults.

survival.vitals: Eat, drink and rest to keep your vitality up. Your stamina can never go higher than it.
survival.sickness: Dirty, poisonous or rotten food makes you sick, and sickness lowers your maximum health.
survival.cold: Being cold limits your vitality. Some clothes are much warmer than others.
survival.rest: Sleeping indoors is more restful than sleeping outside, and a higher comfort rating restores more rest.
survival.shelter: Build a shelter early: it's where you sleep and save.
survival.drying: Drying racks work better in warmer places, and dried food keeps longer than fresh.
survival.cooking: Some cooking recipes give you useful bonuses. Eat well before a long trip.
survival.strength: Hard work raises your strength level, which slightly increases your health, melee damage and tree damage.

building.logs: You can carry two logs at a time. Drop them where you plan to build to save trips.
building.placeSeveral: Hold while placing a structure to put down several in a row.
building.takeApart: Hold to remove a piece you placed, or to pick up a small structure built from the guide book.
building.book: The guide book shows what you can build and lays out each structure where you want it.

companions.kelvin: Kelvin can't hear you. Give him jobs on his notepad: gathering logs, sticks and stones, or finishing a build.

combat.bushes: Crouch in bushes to hide from enemies.
combat.explosives: Explosives and Molotovs work against most enemies. Make a Molotov from cloth and booze.
combat.boneArmour: Burning bodies leaves bones. Bones, rope and duct tape make bone armour.
combat.putAway: Press to put away whatever you're holding.

exploring.gps: Your GPS marks important places on the map. Zoom in for more detail.
exploring.light: Caves are pitch dark. Equip a light before you go in.
exploring.inventory: Tap to open your inventory, or hold for quick select.
exploring.hotkeys: Give items hotkeys in your inventory with the number keys 1 to 0.
exploring.flippers: Flippers make you faster in water but slow you down on land.
exploring.knight: Jump twice to get off the Knight V.
exploring.traps: Build traps to catch small animals while you get on with other work.

seasons.autumn: Winter follows autumn. Dry food and find warmer clothes before the snow.
seasons.winter: Winter makes food scarce and nights cold. Keep a fire going and sleep somewhere warm.
seasons.lakes: In winter the lakes freeze over.

multiplayer.voice: Choose push to talk or always-on voice in the lobby before the game starts.
multiplayer.content: Servers with content mods need the same mods as yours. If they differ, the message says which.

modstoke.photo: Frame a shot of your world. Photo mode is in the pause menu too.
modstoke.photoWorld: Photo mode's World tab sets the time of day and the weather for your shot.
modstoke.photoHere: Photos you take in a world show here the next time you load it.
modstoke.photoFolder: Photos are saved in Pictures > Sons Of The Forest, and can go to your Steam screenshots too.
modstoke.mods: Open your mods at the title or from the pause menu.
modstoke.menuSize: Menus too small or too large? Change the size in {options} > {modstoke} > {menus}.
modstoke.classic: Prefer the game's original menus? Choose them in {options} > {modstoke} > {menus}.
modstoke.language: Modstoke's menus can use a language of their own: {options} > {modstoke} > {language}.
modstoke.loadingArt: Choose the pictures shown here in {options} > {modstoke} > {menus}.

creative.materials: In the inventory, switch the building materials layout.

custom.heading: Custom game
custom.unchanged: Every rule is at its default.

startingSeason.name: Starting season
startingSeason.about: The season the game begins in.

dayLength.name: Day length
dayLength.about: How long a full day and night lasts.

precipitation.name: Rain and snow
precipitation.about: How often it rains or snows.

statsDamage.name: Starvation and thirst
statsDamage.about: Whether going too long without food or water hurts you, and how much.

consumables.name: Bad food and drink
consumables.about: Whether spoiled or rotten food and bad drink hurt you, and how much.

sleepingDelay.name: Sleeping delay
sleepingDelay.about: Sets a minimum time between one sleep and the next.

coldPenalties.name: Cold penalties
coldPenalties.about: How much the cold holds back the return of health and stamina.

recovery.name: Recovery penalties
recovery.about: Slows how fast health and stamina come back.

pausedInInventory.name: Pause in inventory
pausedInInventory.about: The world stops while your inventory is open.

noRefill.name: Containers don't refill
noRefill.about: Containers you have opened stay empty when a save is loaded.

buildingStrength.name: Building strength
buildingStrength.about: How well your buildings stand up to enemy attacks.

ownTraps.name: Players trigger traps
ownTraps.about: Your own traps go off on you and other players. Spring traps always do.

enemies.name: Enemies
enemies.about: Whether enemies appear on the island at all.

enemyHealth.name: Enemy health
enemyHealth.about: How much health enemies start with.

searchParties.name: Search parties
searchParties.about: How often enemies send out search parties.

animals.name: Animals
animals.about: How often animals appear on the island.

cheats.name: Allow cheats
cheats.about: Whether players can use cheats in this game.

pvpDamage.name: PvP damage
pvpDamage.about: How much damage players can deal to each other.

creative.name: Creative building
creative.about: Turns on creative construction, as in Creative mode.

immortal.name: God mode
immortal.about: Players can't die. Needs creative building.

placeFullLoad.name: Group placement
placeFullLoad.about: Places everything you are holding at once. Needs creative building.

noCuttings.name: No cuttings
noCuttings.about: Stops cuttings from appearing. Needs creative building.

oneHitTrees.name: Instant tree chopping
oneHitTrees.about: Trees fall with a single hit. Needs creative building.

serverName.name: Server name
serverName.about: The name other players see in the server list.

players.name: Players
players.about: The most players the game takes at once, you included.

visibility.name: Visibility
visibility.about: A public game is listed for everyone. A private one is left out of the public list, so players join it through you on Steam.

lobby.leaveBody: The lobby closes for everyone in it.
lobby.removeBody: They are asked to leave the lobby.
lobby.ready: Ready when you are. Friends can join through Steam.
lobby.waiting: Waiting for the host to start the game.

pause.title: Paused
pause.quitTitleBody: Anything since your last save is lost.
pause.quitTitleBodyOnline: You leave the game. If you are hosting, it ends for everyone.

photo.title: Photo mode

focal.name: Focal length
focal.about: How much of the scene the lens takes in. Short lengths are wide; long ones bring distant things close and flatten depth.

roll.name: Roll
roll.about: Tilts the camera around its view.

player.name: You
player.about: Whether your character is in the shot. Your head stays hidden while the camera is inside it.

held.name: Held item
held.about: Whether the item in your hands is in the shot.

return.name: Return to you
return.about: Brings the camera back to where you stand.

dof.name: Depth of field
dof.about: Blurs what is nearer or farther than the focus distance, as a real lens does.

focusMode.name: Focus
focusMode.about: Set the distance yourself, or keep whatever is at the centre of the frame sharp.

focusDistance.name: Focus distance
focusDistance.about: How far away the sharpest point is.

aperture.name: Aperture
aperture.about: Wider apertures (smaller numbers) blur more around the focus.

bokeh.name: Blur strength
bokeh.about: Makes out-of-focus areas softer than the lens alone would.

chromatic.name: Colour fringing
chromatic.about: Splits colours at high-contrast edges, as cheap lenses do.

distortion.name: Lens distortion
distortion.about: Bends straight lines outwards or inwards.

panini.name: Wide-angle correction
panini.about: Keeps things at the edges of a wide shot from stretching.

preset.name: Filter
preset.about: A finished look to start from.

strength.name: Filter strength
strength.about: How strongly the filter is applied.

exposure.name: Exposure
exposure.about: Brightens or darkens the whole picture, in stops.

contrast.name: Contrast
contrast.about: The difference between light and dark.

tint.name: Tint
tint.about: Shifts colours towards green or magenta.

grainSize.name: Grain size
grainSize.about: How fine or coarse the grain is.

screenEffects.name: Blood, frost and rain
screenEffects.about: Whether blood, frost and raindrops on the screen show in the shot.

resetLook.name: Reset the look
resetLook.about: Puts the filter, colour and lens back as the game shows them.

time.name: Time of day
time.about: Moves the sun and moon for the photo only; your game's clock doesn't change. Not in caves or other places where the game sets the time. Solar power and other timed switches stay as they are.

weather.name: Weather
weather.about: Changes the sky, rain and snow for the photo only; your game's weather doesn't change. No rain or snow where the game keeps it out, as in caves.

clouds.name: Cloud cover
clouds.about: How much of the sky is covered by cloud.

fog.name: Fog
fog.about: Fills the air with mist and fog.

resetWorld.name: Reset the world
resetWorld.about: Puts the time and weather back as they are in your game.

guide.name: Guide
guide.about: Lines to help you compose. They are not in the photo.

aspect.name: Aspect ratio
aspect.about: The shape of the photo. Outside the frame is left out of the file.

mask.name: Outside the frame
mask.about: How the part left out of the photo is shown.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.about: The size of the saved photo. Larger photos take a moment longer.

detail.name: Detail
detail.about: Fine renders the photo several times over for cleaner edges and foliage.

steam.name: Steam screenshots
steam.about: Also adds each photo to your Steam screenshot library.

world.online: Time and weather can only be changed in single player, where the world is paused.
world.version: Time and weather cannot be changed on this version of the game.

photo.failed: The photo could not be saved: {reason}
photo.closedError: Photo mode closed after a problem. The game is as it was.
photo.closedHurt: Photo mode closed: you were hurt.

unavailable.view: Only while you are out in the world.
unavailable.camera: This view has its own camera.
unavailable.failed: Photo mode is off until you load the game again.

mods.searchAbout: Type to find a mod by its name, ID or author. Enter keeps the search and Escape puts the last one back.
mods.searchHint: Search by name, author or ID
mods.openHint: Select it to open its settings and details.

statusAbout.check: Installed, but something about it needs a look.

players.openHint: Select a player for their Steam profile and what you can do.
players.mutedNote: You have muted them on this PC.
players.kickBody: They leave the game now, but can join again.
players.banBody: They leave the game and cannot join again until you allow them back.

role.adminAbout: Can kick and ban players and change their roles.
role.playerAbout: In this game. The server shares no Steam profile for them.

console.title: Console
console.messageHint: Select a line in the log to read it in full.
console.inputHint: Type a command · Tab completes · Up and Down for history
console.intro: Only commands in the list can run.
console.historyMoved: The log moved on while the console was closed. It now starts at #{id}.
console.pausedNotice: Paused. Lines are still collected and show when you resume; the oldest may be dropped.
console.cleared: View cleared. The shared log is unchanged.
console.unknown: Unknown command. Pick one from the list.
console.unavailable: That command is unavailable right now.
console.changed: The command changed. Check the list and run it again.
console.confirmFirst: It asks you to confirm before it runs.

modpage.opensMenu: Opens in the Mods menu, which has the editor for it.

confirm.keepDisplayBody: If the screen looks wrong, wait and the previous settings come back by themselves.
confirm.quitBody: Sons of the Forest will close and return you to the desktop.
confirm.restartBody: The new graphics API takes effect when the game starts again.
confirm.hungBody: The graphics card stopped responding on DirectX 12 last time and the game closed. From its next start the game draws with DirectX 11 again, as it ships.

empty.filtered: No servers match your search and filters.

details.hostedBy: Hosted by a player over Steam

notice.otherVersion: This server runs another version of Sons of the Forest.
notice.hosted: Hosted games don't list their mods yet; a Modstoke host checks them when you join.
notice.checking: Asking it which mods it runs.
notice.modded: It doesn't list its mods. It may run another loader or an older Modstoke.
notice.vanilla: This server runs no Modstoke, so mods with their own items won't work there.
notice.match: You can join with the mods you have.
notice.addsItems: This server has no mods with their own items, so yours won't exist there.
notice.refused: Its mods with their own items differ from yours.
notice.refusedVersions: Match the versions in the list below.

kick.modsDiffer: Your mods don't match this server's.
kick.needsMods: This server needs mods you don't have.
kick.checkUnfinished: Your game didn't finish this server's mod check. Update Modstoke to the server's version and rejoin.
kick.checksMods: This server checks mods before letting players in. Install the current Modstoke and the same mods, then join it from the Modstoke server list: {mods}.
kick.installModstoke: This server checks mods before letting players in. Install Modstoke and join it from the Modstoke server list.
kick.installModAdmission: This server checks your installed mods before letting players in. Install Modstoke, turn on mod admission in it, then join this server from the Modstoke server list.
kick.turnOnModAdmission: This server checks your installed mods before letting you in, and your Modstoke doesn't take part in that check. Turn on mod admission in Modstoke, then rejoin.
kick.otherVersion: This server runs a different Modstoke version. Install the version the server uses to join.
kick.otherCheck: This server runs a different Modstoke version, and its mod check can't talk to yours.
kick.otherCheckHelp: Install the Modstoke version the server uses, or ask the host to update.
kick.outOfStep: Your game started playing before this server let it in, so the connection is out of step. Rejoin to play.
kick.refusedData: This server refused data from your game. Rejoin to play.
kick.joinUnfinished: Joining this server didn't finish ({reason}). Rejoin to try again.
kick.answeredLate: The server answered Modstoke too late, after your game had started playing.
kick.rejoinHelp: Rejoin to try again. If it keeps happening, install the Modstoke version the server uses.
kick.checkTimedOut: The server didn't finish letting your game in through Modstoke's join check in time.
kick.checkNeedsMore: This server's Modstoke join check needs something your Modstoke doesn't offer.
kick.checkMismatch: This server's Modstoke join check doesn't match yours.
kick.checkBrokeOff: Modstoke's join check with this server broke off.

content.checking: Still checking mods with the server.
content.vanillaAllowed: This server lets in players without mods, so items from mods can't be shared here.
content.serverLacks: This server doesn't run your mods, so their items can't be shared here.
content.unchecked: This session doesn't check mods, so items from mods can't be shared here.
